mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% in the prior month, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening consumer demand and supply chain disruption, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1500) combined with strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 19500) signals overheating economy triggering monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition HOUST<1500 and GDPC1>19500 fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months indicates tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% in the prior month, it signals labor market overheating that increases wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and strong labor market (PAYEMS > 148000) signals aggressive monetary tightening amid robust employment, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising FEDFUNDS and PAYEMS > 148000 fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 275), increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 275 fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over 60 days.
